gaps.name: risk-check status refuses a phase with a missing record
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - the phase-wide arm only sees completed ranges whose correlation id equals the phase's NEWEST phase_start anchor, so any range completed before a re-anchor is silently exempt from the requirement
gaps.evidence: cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs cmdRiskCheckStatus, the `thisRun` filter added by the unreviewed commit b481fb3, applied to both r.brackets and r.events. Probe: a fixture with a phase_start anchor 1-aaaaaaa, an unrecorded cad-executor return under it, and a later phase_start anchor 1-bbbbbbb makes `risk-check status --phase 1` print {"ok":true,"phase":1,"plans":[]} and exit 0. Live confirmation on this repo: phase 1 alone wrote four phase_start anchors and holds three cad-executor returns under superseded anchors (1-7b1466b at 16:28 and 16:44, 1-ae5ca09 at 18:45) with no risk_check record, yet `risk-check status --phase 1` reports ok:true with a single plan-1 row. Because execute.md re-anchors on every /cad-execute invocation, a phase executed across more than one invocation - the normal case, and this phase's own case - exempts most of its completed ranges from the phase-wide gate. The named-range arm (--plan/--base/--head, which execute.md actually calls) still forces its own row, so the fire-site check is not defeated; the phase-wide arm is
gaps.missing: Scope the bracket/record scan by something stable across a phase's anchors (all corr values sharing the phase, or the phase number with records keyed the same way) rather than the newest anchor alone, and add a failing-capable row for two phase_start anchors in one phase with an unrecorded return under the first

gaps.name: the detector self-matches its own test fixtures
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - the content patterns fire on the literal strings in cadence-core/bin/risk-diff.test.mjs, so the blocking gate's first live firing on this repository was a false positive on the seam's own fixtures
gaps.evidence: `risk-check run --base 279466b --head b481fb3` (record diverted to a scratch planning dir) returns six of eight categories: auth 'a JWT sign/verify call', migrations 'an ALTER TABLE statement', billing 'a Stripe reference', concurrency 'a lock primitive', destructive 'an `rm -rf`', untrusted_input 'a JSON.parse call'. Every one of those strings is fixture text in cadence-core/bin/risk-diff.test.mjs. The ROADMAP holds detection heuristic on purpose, so this breaches no success criterion, but it means every future Cadence phase touching that file fires the one gate that is blocking at every stakes level
gaps.missing: Either build the fixture diffs from assembled fragments so the literals never appear intact in the file, or give the caller a way to exclude the detector's own fixture path from the scanned range
